title: Principal Architect, Data & Analytics
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

The Principal Technical Architect provides technical leadership for complex data and analytics solutions across multiple programs and business domains. This role is responsible for translating business strategy into scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions while partnering closely with engineering, product, governance, and business teams. The architect combines strong solution design expertise with practical technical depth to ensure architecture standards, patterns, and best practices are successfully implemented in delivery.

**Technical Responsibilities:**

* Define solution architecture direction, standards, and reference patterns for complex data and analytics initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Own solution design artifacts including architecture diagrams, technical design documents, integration blueprints and data modeling.
* Define reference architectures, design patterns, and reusable components for data ingestion, storage, transformation, and consumption.
* Develop proof-of-concepts, reference implementations, and reusable implementation patterns that accelerate delivery and reduce technical debt across programs.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and platforms, and provide recommendations on fit-for-purpose adoption.
* Conduct architecture, design and code reviews, and technical quality assessments to ensure solutions meet scalability, performance, security, reliability, and supportability requirements.
* Partner with Data Governance and Security teams to embed data privacy, access control, and compliance requirements into solution designs.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and technical evaluations for new platforms, frameworks, advanced analytics capabilities, and architectural approaches to determine business applicability and architectural fit.
* Partner with engineering teams to resolve complex performance, quality, scalability, reliability, integration, and operational challenges.
* Provide technical mentorship to engineers and architects through active engagement in solution design, implementation planning, and delivery reviews.
* Create, maintain and represent architecture documentation, standards, and decision records for the Data and Analytics vertical.
* Partner with Product Management, platform teams and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into practical technical designs, delivery roadmaps, and phased implementation plans.

**Knowledge and Capabilities:**

* Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, including data warehousing, Lakehouse, and real-time streaming architecture.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern data platform ecosystems, and implementation practices across data engineering, integration, analytics, and operational support.
* Ability to design solutions that balance scalability, performance, cost, and maintainability.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture considerations with practical implementation requirements, delivery constraints, and engineering trade-offs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to ambiguous, cross-functional technical challenges.
* Effectively communicates architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and executive audiences.
* Builds credibility and influence across engineering, product, and governance teams without direct authority.
* Proven capability to influence technical decisions through expertise, collaboration, and hands-on technical leadership rather than formal authority.
* Stays current with industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to data and analytics architecture.

**Preferred Skills / Engineering tools:**

* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and Lakehouse technologies, including Azure Data Services, Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, or equivalent enterprise analytics platforms.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and modern data engineering concepts, including ETL/ELT, CDC, dimensional modeling, star-schema design, medallion architecture, distributed data processing, and workload performance optimization.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns and ERP ecosystems such as oracle, JDE, SFDC, SAP S/4HANA, including commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance data domains (modern as well as legacy).
* Experience designing governed data products across bronze, silver, and gold layers, with clear lineage, data quality controls, reconciliation expectations, and consumption-ready semantic layers.
* Experience designing scalable analytics, reporting, semantic model, and business intelligence architectures, including Power BI semantic models, DAX, row-level security, refresh patterns, and performance optimization.
* Strong knowledge of API-based and event-driven integration architectures (Kafka, REST, GraphQL).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, observability, performance optimization, and DevOps practices in cloud-native data platforms.
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and master data management (MDM) frameworks.
* Experience presenting architecture recommendations, solution trade-offs, and implementation approaches to senior technical and business stakeholders.

10+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, or technical design roles, including significant architecture ownership.

* Demonstrated experience architecting large-scale, enterprise data platforms and integration solutions.
* Strong hands-on background in cloud data platforms, data modeling, modern data architecture patterns, Databricks or equivalent Lakehouse platforms, and engineering practices, with demonstrated ability to guide implementation teams through complex technical challenges.
* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams without direct management authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders.

  
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Financial Data Analyst
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

#### **Skills and Competencies**

* 0-2 years in credit/financial data analysis and interpretation; experience in structured finance will be an added advantage
* Basic understanding of how data integrates into credit methodologies and ratings processes
* Ability to read, interpret, and analyze financial metrics and statements
* Engage effectively with team members, managers, and select stakeholders to support deliverables
* Develop working knowledge of multiple simple projects or deliverables under guidance
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (especially Excel) with strong English communication and interpersonal abilities
* Basic understanding of AI concepts (Generative AI tools and Agentic AI systems etc) with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency leveraging these technologies for research, analysis, or workflow optimization. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field
* CFA/ FRM preferred.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Support credit analysis through data, research, and analytical services
* Apply Moody’s standards to financial data to generate adjusted metrics, ratios, and visualizations
* Scrub and validate data for use in ratings and research
* Review financial reports and official statements to assess issuer performance
* Collaborate with analysts and accounting specialists to interpret accounting treatments
* Assist rating teams by gathering and preparing data inputs
* Perform calculations and apply judgment to support analytical outputs
* Maintain databases and complete deliverables such as newsletters and ad-hoc reports.

#### **About the team**

Being part of the RRS Global Capability Centers provides a unique opportunity to foster skills that are valuable to any future career in the financial services industry. The RRS GCC teams perform a range of data, analytical and research services that contribute to the overall credit analysis function performed by the rating groups. By joining our team, you will be a part of exciting work in the global capability centers.

  

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Data Information Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Job Description

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

  

Citi's Mission and Value Proposition explains what we do and Citi Leadership Standards explain how we do it. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

Diversity is a key business imperative and a source of strength at Citi. We serve clients from every walk of life, every background and every origin. Our goal is to have our workforce reflect this same diversity at all levels. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work, where individuals are promoted based on merit, where we value and demand respect for others and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all.

**The Operations MIS team** focuses on creating reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to provide actionable insights for various business functions, including USPB WFM & Customer Service and Wealth Ops MIS. They are responsible for building and maintaining datamarts, migrating legacy BI tools to modern platforms like Tableau, and automating data refreshes for dashboards. Projects include tracking ATM availability and performance, managing service tickets, and upgrading software for uninterrupted service. They aim to empower business stakeholders with accurate and timely information for strategic decision-making. Their work also supports capacity planning and issue remediation efforts.

  

The **Data/Information Analyst** is a developing professional role. Applies specialty area knowledge in monitoring, assessing, analyzing and/or evaluating processes and data. Identifies policy gaps and formulates policies. Interprets data and makes recommendations. Researches and interprets factual information. Identifies inconsistencies in data or results, defines business issues and formulates recommendations on policies, procedures or practices. Integrates established disciplinary knowledge within own specialty area with basic understanding of related industry practices. Good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area. Develops working knowledge of industry practices and standards. Limited but direct impact on the business through the quality of the tasks/services provided. Impact of the job holder is restricted to own team.

**In this role, you're expected to:**

* Gathers operational data from various cross functional stakeholders to examine past business performance
* Identifies data patterns & trends, and provides insights to enhance business decision making capability in business planning, process improvement, solution assessment etc.
* Recommends actions for future developments & strategic business opportunities, as well as enhancements to operational policies.
* May be involved in exploratory data analysis, confirmatory data analysis and/or qualitative analysis.
* Translate data into consumer or customer behavioral insights to drive targeting and segmentation strategies, and communicate clearly and effectively to business partners and senior leaders all findings
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**As a successful candidate, should ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* **Data Warehousing & BI Tools:** Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and experience working with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* **Reporting & Dashboard Development:** Proficiency in developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using reporting tools and data visualization techniques. Ability to create clear and concise visualizations of key data.
* **Data Management & SQL:** Expertise in data management principles, SQL programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems.
* **Communication & Stakeholder Management:** Ability to effectively communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with business partners to understand reporting requirements.
* **Automation & Scripting:** Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python) and automation tools (e.g., SSIS) for automating report generation, data refreshes, and other routine tasks.

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 2-5 years with Masters as Educational background, 4-7 years with Bachelors as Education background
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with process mapping and process or workflow automation tools.
* Technical Skills: Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems. Including Tableau, and other BI tools.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.
* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Excellent interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

-

**Job Family Group:**
---------------------

Decision Management

-

**Job Family:**
---------------

Data/Information Management

-

**Time Type:**
--------------

Full time

-

**Most Relevant Skills**
------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

-

**Other Relevant Skills**
-------------------------

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

-

title: Market, Technology & Policy Analyst, Energy Transition
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

09

**The Role: Market, Technology & Policy Analyst, Energy Transition**

  

**The Team:** S&P Global Energy gives customers an integrated, data-driven picture of the energy transition, linking big-picture trends to asset-level detail so they can make business and financing decisions and allocate capital across changing energy systems. You will join a rapidly growing, successful team spread across Europe, Asia and the Americas, working with a global network of analysts and data teams to source, align and put data-driven insight into practice.

  

**Responsibilities and Impact:** You will use your industry knowledge, analytical skills and communication skills to produce high-quality work that supports critical business decisions, in a fast-paced environment where you keep building your market expertise. Your focus will be data analytics, integration and visualization:

* Aggregate and manage diverse datasets, keeping them consistent, traceable and well documented, and safeguard data quality through validation, cross-checking and triangulation.
* Produce clear, high-impact visualizations with transparent assumptions and reproducible logic.
* Where possible, build and automate data pipelines and content-generation workflows, so outputs scale.
* Connect datasets across markets, technologies and value chains to surface emerging patterns, gaps and implications.
* Formulate short, fast and impactful analysis of recent trends and how they affect the wider energy system.
* Support fast-turnaround outputs with reliable, scalable data inputs, working across analyst, data and product teams worldwide.
  

**What We’re Looking For:**

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

* An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 3+ years of experience in renewable energy, energy storage, power markets, market research, consulting, or a related industry
* Prior exposure to energy markets or infrastructure, gained through education or work experience, is essential, as is a solid grasp of energy transition dynamics.
* Degree in a quantitative field (e.g. economics, engineering, data science).
* Strong working knowledge of programming and data tools for data extraction, transformation and automation, and a strong grasp of visualisation principles (clarity, consistency, comparability).
  

**Key soft skills:**

* Structured and detail-oriented, keeping shared datasets and outputs clean.
* Clear, pragmatic communicator who takes feedback constructively.
* Works independently while building strong relationships across a global team of analysts, data and product colleagues.
  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks or similar data platforms.
* + Experience improving workflows, automation or data processes.
* AI fluency: understands what AI can and cannot do, treats AI outputs as hypotheses to test through triangulation and dataset checks, and knows that designing the full task context (data, assumptions, constraints, sources) matters more than prompting alone.
* Systems thinking: connects signals across markets, technologies and value chains to find patterns and gaps rather than just describing trends.
  

**Key soft skills:**

* Takes ownership of decisions and accountability for outputs; AI supports the analysis, but responsibility stays with you.
* Recognises the limits of analysis and tools, and tells plausible outputs from correct ones.
* Works across teams to source data, align assumptions and improve outputs.

**About S&P Global Energy**  
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at www.spglobal.com/energy .

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
Our benefits include:

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
* Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

**Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:**

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert:**

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here .

-

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

S&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

**Role Purpose:**

The Business Analyst (P2) is an experienced individual contributor responsible for configuring systems to meet complex business requirements. With at least 2 years of experience, the role involves analyzing business and system specifications, executing platform configurations, and developing thorough unit test plans. The analyst ensures system functionality aligns with client needs through rigorous testing and clear documentation. Collaboration with developers and stakeholders is key to delivering timely, high-quality solutions. This role suits professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments and are passionate about system analysis, implementation, and continuous improvement.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibility:**

  

* Platform Configuration
* Execute configuration tasks on the designated platform.
* Ensure setup aligns with client-specific infrastructure plans (Hardware, Database, Data Center).
* Requirement Analysis
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business and system requirements.
* Translate functional needs into technical specifications.
* SQL/PLSQL Scripting
* Develop and optimize SQL/PLSQL scripts to support system functionality.
* Validate scripts against business logic and performance standards.
* Documentation
* Maintain detailed records of configurations, solutions, and issue resolutions.
* Ensure documentation is clear, comprehensive, and accessible for future reference.
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Sr. Implementation Lead, Implementation Lead, and Sr. Business Analyst.
* Support the system development lifecycle to ensure timely and accurate delivery of client requirements.
* Platform Configuration
* Perform detailed configuration tasks within GGB platforms to support client-specific implementations.
* Ensure platform settings are optimized for performance and compliance with business rules.
* Advanced Requirement Analysis
* Review and interpret complex business requirements and system specifications, including Health & Welfare plan calculations, data conversions, payroll interfaces, and employee self-service (ESS) modules.
* Translate business logic into executable SQL/PLSQL code with precision.
* Defect Management
* Investigate and resolve reported bugs, anomalies, and enhancement requests using a defect tracking system.
* Collaborate with QA and development teams to ensure timely resolution and quality assurance.
* Solution Delivery & Documentation
* Ensure all system solutions are completed successfully and documented thoroughly.
* Maintain clear records of configurations, resolutions, and implementation steps for audit and support purposes.
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Assist in gathering requirements and defining unit test cases during various phases of the system development lifecycle.
* Review and provide feedback on work performed by other scripters to maintain consistency and quality.
* Stakeholder Alignment
* Work closely with developers and senior business analysts to ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of solutions.
* Support release planning by validating that requirements are well understood and achievable within scheduled timelines.

  
  
**About you**

**Skills:**

  

* Technical Proficiency: SQL, PL/SQL, Microsoft Word, Excel, Access
* Education: B.Tech. (CS) / MCA / M.Sc. (CS)
* Domain Knowledge: Exposure to Health & Welfare pension plans (US/CAN/UK) preferred
* Analytical Strength: Strong problem-solving, detail orientation, and ability to synthesize complex data
* Project Execution: Multitasking, deadline commitment, ownership of tasks
* Communication: Clear written and verbal skills; client-focused and team-oriented
* Work Ethic: High integrity, accountability, and adaptability in fast-paced environments
* Passion Areas: System analysis, documentation, testing, and implementation

  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning

title: Business Systems Analyst 3
description:
We are seeking an experienced, techno-functional Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with broad experience across enterprise finance systems and processes, including accounting, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P). The ideal candidate will bridge business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver system enhancements, integrations, automation, and process improvements across the finance function. The role requires an understanding of end-to-end finance processes, requirements gathering, functional configuration, integration design, testing, production support, and stakeholder management.

### **1. Business Analysis and Process Management**

* Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Finance, and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution designs
* Analyze and optimize end-to-end finance processes, including general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close
* Conduct fit-gap analysis and recommend scalable solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirement reviews, and solution walkthroughs

### **2. Integrations and Technical Collaboration**

* Work with integration developers to define interface requirements, data mappings, transformation rules, and error-handling mechanisms
* Support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, flat files, and middleware or iPaaS platforms
* Analyze integration failures, data discrepancies, synchronization issues, and transaction errors
* Document interface specifications, field mappings, dependencies, and reconciliation procedures
* Collaborate with ERP teams, particularly NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle, to support financial postings and master data synchronization

### **3. Testing, Deployment, and Production Support**

* Develop test scenarios, test cases, and test data for system enhancements and integrations
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
* Coordinate defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution with technical teams
* Support release management, deployment validation, and post-implementation stabilization
* Maintain functional documentation, configuration records, support procedures, and knowledge articles

### **4. Governance, Controls, and Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure solutions align with internal controls, audit requirements, segregation of duties, and financial compliance standards
* Support access reviews, approval hierarchy validation, and audit evidence collection
* Manage incidents, service requests, and enhancement backlogs using tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and resolutions to business and technical stakeholders
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous process improvement

### **Required Qualifications and Skills**

* 6+ years of experience in business systems analysis, enterprise applications, or finance systems
* Strong techno-functional experience with enterprise finance systems
* Good understanding of core finance and accounting processes, such as general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close
* Experience gathering requirements and creating functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution documentation
* Practical understanding of APIs, integration patterns, data mapping, file-based interfaces, and troubleshooting
* Experience with functional testing, UAT coordination, defect management, and production support
* Familiarity with Finance systems such as NetSuite, Concur, COUPA etc
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business users, developers, and integration teams

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with finance systems integrations involving ERP, CRM, billing, HR, banking, procurement, and other business platforms
* Familiarity with SQL, data analysis, API testing tools such as Postman, and integration monitoring
* Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-subsidiary, or global finance environments
* Knowledge of SOX controls, audit requirements, approval governance, and financial reconciliations
* Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, ServiceNow, and ITIL-based support processes

### **Key Success Criteria**

* Accurate translation of business requirements into effective system solutions
* Reliable operation of finance systems business processes and integrations
* Reduced transaction errors, integration failures, and manual intervention
* Timely resolution of production issues and delivery of system enhancements
* Improved user experience, process efficiency, compliance, and audit readines

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

We are looking for Senior Analysts to join our Chemicals team, working across our Base Chemicals and Plastics, Fibres & Recycling products. Within the team, you will cover and drive regional market analysis for a specified product, and play a significant role in our integrated global analysis. In both areas, you will contribute to the commercial success of the team, working closely with sales to set out a clear path to success.

**The successful applicants will:**

* Research and validate markets, assets, ownerships and strategies and will assist in producing cost, price and margin forecasts at the regional and global levels.
* Produce high-quality research in the form of thought-provoking reports, presentations and articles and will contribute to bespoke consulting projects.
* Participate in major industry events and conferences.
* Coach other team members and junior analysts in the chemicals team and related commodities.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* You will lead the coverage of specified chemicals markets for selected regions and through our short- and long-term market services for these regions.
* Co-ordinate global views with analysts in other regions to deliver a truly integrated view of chemicals markets.
* Maintain and improve in-house databases of industry information including inputting, updating and checking the consistency and integrity of data.
* Conduct primary and secondary research to build, expand and improve the quality of our proprietary data.
* Review, prioritise and analyse the data and information which you gather and use it to produce quantitative and qualitative commentaries for in-depth reports and presentations of the highest quality.
* Establish relationships with clients, building on existing business contacts, establishing rapport and trust, particularly with individuals in sales, marketing and buying functions
* Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to service clients and grow the client base.

**Qualifications:**

* The successful candidate will have substantive experience in an analytical role. Relevant market knowledge of the chemical sector would be advantageous. You will have good knowledge of commodity product behaviours, and capability to identify key drivers (such as macroeconomic indicators, industrial/consumer activities, domestic prices, etc.) so that their effects on production, demand, price and trade are quantified in models by product and sector.
* You are comfortable collecting and interpreting data, articulating your findings in a clear and insightful manner.
* You also have a flair for written communications and confidence when presenting your insights to small and large groups.
* You are looking for a role where you can build on your existing knowledge and learn from others in a collaborative, commercial and customer-centric environment.
* You also enjoy sharing what you have learnt with others.
* You are able to work independently and as part of a team, generating ideas you want to share. The way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class.
* If you are looking for a new opportunity in chemicals, or to expand your existing network of customers and contacts in the industry, then this role will enable you to use your effective client engagement skills.

In addition, candidates must have:

* A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline
* Fluent English language skills, both oral and written

We are looking for a Senior Analyst to join our Thermal Coal Markets Research team. This role will be based in India, joining a global team of well-established experts. As part of the Metals and Mining Research Unit, the Thermal Coal Markets team is responsible for delivering comprehensive research coverage of global thermal coal markets, covering supply, demand, and pricing. Wood Mackenzie’s high-quality thermal coal research provides value to our clients, by providing a guide to the rapidly transitioning energy sector and assisting clients to make the best commercial decisions to secure their business success.

**Main Responsibilities**

* As part of a world-class team of industry experts, you will conduct original quantitative and qualitative research on the global thermal coal market and deliver analysis through the creation of data services, proprietary data, written reports, public speaking, and custom research engagements. This role will involve modelling the trajectory of the coal market globally and corresponding subregions in the long-term. Further, you will work closely with members across the commodities, energy and natural resources business globally to help determine the pace and shape of the energy transition. You will produce regular and timely deliverables about the thermal coal market.
* Through your efforts, you will strengthen your and WoodMac’s profile, building relationships with contacts at key companies and government bodies. You will develop a unique perspective and understanding of the thermal coal industry. Your knowledge will be highly valued by WoodMac's clients, with whom you will share your insight via industry-leading written reports, economic models, and presentations.
* Your contributions will be influential from the beginning. You will be in demand and able to make a difference as we value high levels of client contact and pride ourselves in answering their questions.

**About You**

* You are degree-qualified in a relevant discipline (Economics, Business, Mining, Geology, Engineering etc.) and have experience in the metals and mining and/or energy sectors. Your previous experience includes generating forecasts for thermal coal or energy supply, demand, prices, and trade. You may also have experience with mines, power plants, traders, or other users of thermal coal and experience with their operations.
* You also understand the big picture, which enables you to analyse and form clear, coherent conclusions from a variety of data and information. You find it easy to communicate complex or technical information and delivering messages that are easily understood. You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment.
* You have a high understanding of the Microsoft Office suite of products. You may have advanced skills utilising these products or programming languages. You have experience with relational databases.
* You are thoughtful, intellectually curious, creative and comfortable presenting to public audiences and interacting with small groups of executives.
* You have a proven track record of fostering strong working relationships, developing networks and influencing others. The way you work is productive and driven, striving to be the best in class. You often share ideas, find better ways of working, and make things happen.

**Deliverables**

* Produce analysis and written content for our long- and short-term coal market outlooks
* Maintain excellent client relationships for both providing and gathering information by reaching out to subscribers, giving tailored presentations
* Gain industry presence through a firm network of client relationships and conference speaking slots
* Collaborating across global teams and functions in order to build strong connections, identify opportunities, ensure consistency of message, and grow our team’s influence
* Deliver on commercial product enhancements that help us to stay ahead of competitors and grow revenue
* Ensure content quality and editorial integrity of the coal markets products
* Work closely with consulting to deliver on tailored projects as needed

**Expectations**

* Key capabilities:
  + Planning and prioritising - aligning our efforts to organisational goals and priorities
  + Ownership and accountability - delivering on our commitments and owning the outcome
  + Commitment to action - making timely decisions and taking action
  + Continuous improvement - continuously striving for better in all we do
* We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, but this may be subject to change in the future.
* While this is expected to be a full-time role, part-time or flexible working arrangements will be considered.
* Due to the global nature of the team, a degree of flexible working will be required to accommodate different time zones.

title: Associate Business Analyst
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

The Associate Business Analyst is an entry-level, individual contributor role designed for freshers eager to launch their career in business systems and IT implementation. This position plays a critical part in configuring platform solutions aligned with client H&W (US/CAN) / Flex (UK) plans, analyzing system requirements, and developing SQL/PLSQL scripts to meet operational needs. The role demands a detail-oriented approach to unit testing, defect tracking, and comprehensive documentation. Working closely with senior team members, the Associate Business Analyst supports the full system development lifecycle to ensure timely and accurate delivery of client requirements. This is an ideal opportunity for individuals with a passion for data, systems, and collaborative problem-solving in a dynamic technical environment.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**  

* **Platform Configuration**
* Execute configuration tasks on the designated platform.
* Ensure setup aligns with client-specific infrastructure plans (Hardware, Database, Data Center).
* **Requirement Analysis**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business and system requirements.
* Translate functional needs into technical specifications.
* **SQL/PLSQL Scripting**
* Develop and optimize SQL/PLSQL scripts to support system functionality.
* Validate scripts against business logic and performance standards.
* **Documentation**
* Maintain detailed records of configurations, solutions, and issue resolutions.
* Ensure documentation is clear, comprehensive, and accessible for future reference.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Sr. Implementation Lead, Implementation Lead, and Sr. Business Analyst.
* Support the system development lifecycle to ensure timely and accurate delivery of client requirements.

  
**About you**  

* **Technical Proficiency:** SQL, PL/SQL, Microsoft Word, Excel, Access
* **Education:** B.Tech. (CS) / MCA / M.Sc. (CS)
* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to Health & Welfare pension plans (US/CAN/UK) preferred

* **Analytical Strength:** Strong problem-solving, detail orientation, and ability to synthesize complex data
* **Project Execution:** Multitasking, deadline commitment, ownership of tasks
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal skills; client-focused and team-oriented
* **Work Ethic:** High integrity, accountability, and adaptability in fast-paced environments
* **Passion Areas:** System analysis, documentation, testing, and implementation
* Any Engineering Graduate or Postgraduate in Computers

  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Demonstrated experience working with PBM / pharmacy data ecosystems
* Serve as SME for PBM data analytics, using advanced SQL to answer complex questions
* Translate analysis into business-ready narratives-clear insights, quantified impacts, and practical recommendations
* Work with large datasets received from multiple sources and housed in data warehouses ensure data is usable for reporting and analytical purposes
* Partner with stakeholders to provide training/UAT support to business users on analytic outputs and definitions to increase adoption and reduce rework
* Collaborate with Engineering/IT to design and implement right workflows, ensuring data extracts are migrated efficiently and securely
* Apply solid understanding of dimensional modeling and relational database concepts
* Act as an escalation point for complex analytic issues; provide timely updates to leadership and business partners
* Ensure adherence to governance standards for healthcare data, including privacy, access controls, and secure handling of sensitive datasets
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree (Business, Computer Science, or related field) or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience designing, developing, testing, implementing scalable BI/analytic solutions and working with relational databases
* Proven hands-on expertise in SQL for analytics and data manipulation; experience with large datasets in warehouse environments
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI / Tableau and enabling self-service analytics
* Experience designing or partnering on ETL/ELT processes and maintaining documentation (data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage)
* Experience applying data security/compliance best practices in healthcare/regulated environments
* Solid analytical/problem-solving skills; solid written and verbal communication skills; ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders
* Solid proficiency with SQL; ability to profile and validate large volumes of structured data
* Ability to coach/mentor junior analysts and act as a go-to resource for complex analytics
* Solid stakeholder management and ability to influence without authority
* Familiar with PBM Domain Data

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Global People Analytics Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As part of the Global People Analytics team, you will play a pivotal role in driving people analytics at BCG across regions and businesses.

You will be working very closely with senior business leaders across geographies, to understand their business challenges & priorities, and translate those into analytical problem statements to drive more effective decision making using people data.

A large part of this role will require relationship building & thought partnering with senior stakeholders across People teams.

You will be leading a suite of data and analytics products within the Global People Analytics team. You will be the point of contact for senior functional leaders across our People Teams, to support their analytics needs and problem solve using analytical frameworks and data.

Key focus would be to drive the analytics roadmap for employee engagement by working in conjunction with the analytics content owners and senior leaders across the employee engagement teams.

The role creates clarity, solves problems and drives alignment whilst appropriately adjusting for geographic and business unit nuances. It shapes metrics, scorecards and analyses required to track performance against the strategic People agenda for People teams and uses data to shape the leadership discussions required to drive change.

Strong problem solving, networking, influencing and communication skills (verbal, written and PowerPoint) are absolutely essential.

What You'll Bring

* 8-13 years’ experience in leading high impact data & analytics projects, and working with senior stakeholders
* Advanced know-how in reporting & analytics tools like Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, DBT and/ or web-based reporting tools (must have)
* Working knowledge of programing languages like SQL or Python (must have)
* Very strong influencing, networking and relationship building skills
* Project and change management experience
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Client/executive level presentation preparation experience
* Relevant educational qualifications such as an MBA or an advanced degree
* Experience with HR data (good to have)

Who You'll Work With

* Employee Surveys, Diversity and Teaming @BCG leadership
* Global People team leadership
* Product Owners and Chapter Leads on Global People Analytics team
* Product & Technical Team Leads on People Portfolio
* Other regional people analytics teams

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Driving forward a complex, ambiguous agenda via influence and persuasion
* Engaging and influencing senior stakeholders to steer a strategic agenda
* Building trust-based relationships and networks with local, regional and global functional leaders
* Collaborative problem solving that results in buy-in to win-win solutions
* Working with challenging stakeholders across cultures to drive change
* Rigorous, accurate data analysis from which comes insight and practical courses of action
* Verbal and written communication including with senior audiences

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Associate Analyst - Reliability Ops Support
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.  
  
**Job Overview and Responsibilities**

The Technical Operations Reliability team ensures United operates safely and dependably by analyzing aircraft defects and operational disruptions. The team monitors trends to notify maintenance and engineering teams of emerging issues and probable corrective actions. The Associate Analyst will aim to provide accurate information and useful insights to help multiple divisions make better data-driven decisions.

* Provide accurate and useful data on time including, but not limited to, identifying ATA codes for tech ops interruptions, identifying component/ condition/ other details for system failures, identifying top system failures, supporting fleet reliability meetings
* Regulatory reporting and operational support, including dispositioning chronic items
* Tracking fleet trends and highlighting potential issues by performing operational drill-downs
* Supporting ongoing reliability/fleet initiatives, ad-hoc requests and reporting needs

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* Bachelors degree in aeronautical engineering, aircraft maintenance, other engineering or related disciplines
* 6 months - 2 years of experience in aviation, or related fields
* Knowledge of aircraft systems
* Superior attention to accuracy and detail
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Must be legally authorized to work in India for any employer without sponsorship
* Must be fluent in English (written and spoken)
* Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
* Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

**What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**

* Knowledge of aircraft fleet health and/or reliability programs preferred
* Familiarity with using database querying tools, such as SQL, and data visualization/ reporting tools preferred

title: Research Analyst - Oils and Chems
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

Wood Mackenzie is the global research, analytics, and consultancy business powering the natural resources industry. For 50 years, we have been providing the quality data, analytics, and insights our customers rely on to inspire their decision making. Our dedicated oil, gas & LNG, power & renewables, chemicals, metals & mining sector teams are located around the world and deliver a variety of projects based on our assessment and valuation of thousands of individual assets, companies, and economic indicators such as market supply, demand, and price trends. We have leading specialists in over 30 locations, serving customers in nearly 80 countries. Together, we inspire and innovate the markets we serve – providing invaluable intelligence to help our customers overcome the toughest challenges, and make strategic decisions that will, ultimately, accelerate the world’s transition to a more sustainable future.

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer Committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie brand video**

**Role Purpose**

We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply-demand research to price-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.

We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. We help our Sales team retain and win new business by spending time with customers and answering questions that matter to them. We work closely with colleagues in our Data and Product functions to maintain the quality of our published data and to deliver content via our**growing Lens platform****.**

Through carrying out primary research, responding to customer questions, and presenting to industry stakeholders, you will build relationships and a network of contacts at key operators, national bodies, and other relevant institutions. Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.

**Main Responsibilities**

We are looking for an enthusiastic Research Analyst to join our Refined Products and Transport Fuels team. The main focus of the role will be to analyse the global fuels retail and marketing sector. We are seeking a candidate who is passionate about the future of fuels retailing and how it will develop in the coming decades to meet the needs of society in a sustainable manner.

The successful candidate will join a global team of analysts and industry experts undertaking fundamental research and modelling of aspects of the retail fuels value chains. The role offers the opportunity to develop modelling and forecasting skills and comprehensive industry knowledge through regular interaction with other members of the global Oils and Chemicals team. The successful candidate will be required to collaborate closely with cross-functional research teams to integrate perspectives, require an analytical mindset, an eye for detail, strong communication skills and the ability to provide strategic insights to our clients via presentations, webinars, or emails, in a prompt and professional manner.

Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.

* **Research and data gathering** – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.
* **Analysis** – we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for and tell stories to our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* **Internal engagement** – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the commodities sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
* **External engagement** – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
* **Leadership/ Process Improvement** – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive.

**About You**

You have demonstrable interest and relevant experience in the downstream oil sector. Experience in fuels retailing and oil product marketing operations, or downstream oil-related market research and/or consulting projects would be an advantage. You are highly numerate, with a high attention to detail and proven analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling you to formulate leading-edge analysis from a variety of data and information. You are focused on continuous improvement and play a key role in implementing better ways of working, including your ability to synthesize solutions/ automations leveraging use of AI.

* **Keen interest in refined oil products and retail fuels market dynamics -** You have a keen interest in understanding how fuel retailing and marketing markets operate across different countries and how they are evolving through the energy transition. You can undertake analysis of market structure, competitive dynamics, company strategies, consumer behaviour and changing fuels and mobility trends to develop an integrated view of the retail fuels sector. You can monitor market developments, maintain relevant datasets and analytical models, and contribute to high-quality research and commentary as part of a global team, while developing an understanding of how companies are adapting their strategies and business models to changing market conditions.

* **Analytical mindset and eye for detail -** You're comfortable collecting and interpreting data, clearly articulating your findings, and seeking to enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You can develop compelling narratives from researched/ available data points to present a strong view of the current market scenario and write insightful commentary on the challenges and opportunities for the refined products/ chemicals markets. You can maintain and develop data models, methodology and other intellectual property related to the industry. You have experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, which helps you present your findings in a visually compelling way.

* **Highly adaptive team player -** You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment. You will have a proven dedication to meeting the needs of clients and responding to feedback to make service improvements. The way in which you work enables you to build strong, collaborative relationships and influence at all levels. You use this engagement commercially to understand client perspectives and what is important to their business decisions.

* **Excellent communication skills -** Your strong command of English, both written and spoken, allows you to communicate effectively in the globalised commodity market. You can support with client engagement and showcase the ability to understand and execute client enquiries and ad hoc requests in a timely and professional manner.

**Expectations**

* **Growth mindset** - taking the initiative to learn new skills, seeking out feedback and actively applying what has been learned in the workplace.

* **Change agility** - maintaining high performance through disruption and change.

  

* We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be **expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week** to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. This is subject to change per company policy.

  

* This is a full-time role.

**Diversity is at the core of our business** and we welcome applications from a range of academic or professional backgrounds.

Hear what our team has to say about working with us:https://www.woodmac.com/careers/our-people/

title: Senior Commercial Analyst
description:
About the Role

* The Senior Commercial Analyst is the bridge between analysis and decision-making. You will independently lead major NRM modules, synthesize multiple sources of evidence into a coherent answer, and work directly with market and brand stakeholders to shape practical commercial recommendations.
* This role is designed for experienced industry hires and ex-consultants who want to combine consulting-style problem solving with direct ownership of Revenue Growth Management decisions. Strong candidates may come from strategy consulting, RGM/pricing, commercial finance, consumer insights, revenue analytics, category strategy or other growth-oriented roles.
  

  

Key Responsibilities

* + Lead one or more analytical / strategy modules within global NRM engagements across strategic pricing, value architecture, menu optimization, consumer strategy, channel economics, promotions and unit economics.
* + Structure ambiguous commercial problems into hypotheses, issue trees, analytical workplans and clear decision questions; guide analysts and specialists on the work required to answer them.
* + Synthesize transaction data, consumer research, competitor intelligence, cost and P&L information, market context and revenue science outputs into a single commercial point of view.
* + Develop strategic pricing and revenue recommendations using evidence from realized price, price ladders, elasticity, market basket, willingness-to-pay research, competitive price indices, margin and traffic risk.
* + Shape menu and value architecture across ALC, Everyday Value, Disruptive Value, Good-Better-Best tiers, group sizes, dayparts and channels; identify gaps, cannibalization, trade-up and premiumization opportunities.
* + Quantify opportunity size and business impact, connecting recommendations to transactions, SSSG/SSTG, AUV, revenue, COS%, contribution margin, unit economics and EBITDA through scenario and sensitivity analysis.
* + Lead stakeholder interviews, working sessions and workshops with Marketing, Finance, Operations, Digital, Insights and market leadership; build alignment around the answer and the actions required.
* + Own executive-ready storylines, presentations and recommendation pages, ensuring every analysis connects to a clear "so what", "now what" and financial ambition.
* + Partner closely with the Data & Revenue Science pod to frame model requirements, challenge outputs and ensure analytical results are commercially interpretable and actionable.
* + Coach Commercial Analysts, raise the quality bar on analyses and slides, and build reusable NRM frameworks, playbooks and thought leadership.

Capability Ownership

* Senior Commercial Analysts are expected to build distinctive depth in a Primary NRM capability while developing a Secondary capability. Examples include Strategic Pricing, Consumer & Value, Menu / Merchandising, Commercial Finance, Channel / Digital, or Operations / Unit Economics.

What Success Looks Like

* + You can independently own a module, not just the analyses - you know what question matters, what evidence is needed and what decision should follow.
* + You connect multiple analyses into one commercial answer and can defend the recommendation with senior stakeholders.
* + You combine analytical rigor with practical judgment, recognizing when the model needs to be balanced with consumer, operational or franchisee realities.
* + You make junior team members better through clear direction, feedback and high standards.
  

  

Qualifications

* + Bachelor’s degree required; MBA / PGDM / PGP or other relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
* + Typically 5-8+ years of relevant experience in strategy consulting, Revenue Growth Management, strategic pricing, commercial strategy, finance, consumer insights, analytics or related growth roles.
* + Strong structured problem-solving and quantitative skills, with demonstrated ability to work with large commercial datasets and build scenario-based recommendations.
* + Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; strong data visualization and executive storytelling capability.
* + Experience managing senior stakeholders and leading workshops or cross-functional working sessions.
* + Strong written and oral communication skills, with confidence operating in global and multicultural environments
